subject: Re: BlueHarbor discovery — next steps & EoQ timing?
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: BlueHarbor discovery - recap & next steps

Jordan — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our 30-min call and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we loop in procurement:

- Key priorities you shared: reduce per-API token cost for batch document summarization, maintain 99th-pct latency under 300ms for customer-facing flows, and support a VPC deployment for sensitive accounts.
- Current constraints: initial PO expected this quarter if exec sign-off comes through; procurement needs SOC2 evidence and a short SOW.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll share a short mutual action plan and a draft SOW for your legal/procurement this afternoon.
2) Marissa (cc) will schedule a technical review next week to go over latency profiles and our Dedicated options.
3) Jordan to confirm procurement contacts + timing.

Attachments: BH-SOW-draft-v1.pdf (draft; placeholders for billable rates), Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (editable MAP).

If the end-of-quarter timeline is still accurate on your side, we’ll prioritize a canary deployment plan that meets your latency SLOs. If timing shifted, tell us and we’ll adjust cadence.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0124
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@blueharbor.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor discovery - recap & next steps

Grace — appreciate the recap and the fast follow. Everything looks right from my side. A couple quick answers:

- Procurement: looping in Alex Tan (cc) who owns SaaS contracting. Alex — can you confirm SOC2 evidence and expected review timeline?
- Timing: leadership wants an internal cost/benefit modeled this quarter; procurement usually needs ~2 weeks for a straightforward SaaS SOW.

I'll introduce our security lead if they want a quick 30-min dive on SOC2 artifacts. Please send the MAP and SOW and Marissa’s team can take the technical deep dive.

Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
BlueHarbor Financial
j.ellis@blueharbor.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@blueharbor.com>, Alex Tan <a.tan@blueharbor.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor discovery - draft SOW + MAP attached

Alex / Procurement team — attaching the draft SOW and our MAP as promised. Highlights for legal/procurement review:
- SOW: term, termination, data controls, and rate card for Dedicated capacity and private VPC option.
- MAP: milestone-driven plan with target dates (canary test week, production rollout, SLA acceptance).

Attachments: BH-SOW-draft-v1.pdf, Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx

Marissa will host the technical review on Wednesday 23rd (proposed) — she will follow up with an invite and agenda. If procurement prefers a different review scope, tell us and we’ll adapt.

Thanks —
Grace

---
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 08:59:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check: EoQ timing + approval path (bumping MAP)

Jordan — bumping this thread as I haven't seen procurement confirmation yet. End-of-quarter is this Friday for our mutual calendars and I wanted to confirm whether the approval path (exec sign-off → procurement review → PO) is still the expected route. Quick asks: 

- Has leadership reconfirmed the EoQ priority for this initiative?
- Can procurement aim to complete review by Tue 22 Jul so we can align on a PO before your fiscal close?

If timing slipped, no problem — just tell us the new window and we’ll shift the proposed MAP accordingly. We can also scope a pilot that fits a longer timeline if that helps budget approvals.

If helpful, I can send a 1-page exec brief summarizing ROI and latency guarantees for your CFO/CTO.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: BH-Exec-OnePager.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@blueharbor.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Tan <a.tan@blueharbor.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@blueharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick check: EoQ timing + approval path (bumping MAP)

Grace — thanks for the nudge and for the materials. Short update: leadership asked to deprioritize a few Q3 initiatives to free runway for a different infrastructure project, so our EoQ push for this has moved out slightly. Procurement (Alex) still wants to review the SOW, but our internal PO cadence will now target early August rather than this week.

That said — we remain interested. Please proceed with the technical review with Marissa so we can validate latency numbers; having the cost/ROI one-pager will help accelerate internal alignment when procurement completes their review.

Alex — feel free to coordinate directly with Grace on any SOC2 artifacts you need.

Appreciate the follow-up.

Jordan
